props.name: capability
props.remarks: Institutional capability enabling trusted use of externally asserted identities across organizational boundaries.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Federated identity and trust services, independent of protocol or vendor.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Federated identity broker with explicit trust agreements and assurance signaling.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Digital Identity represented in federated assertions.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Federated identity assertions and federation metadata.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Federation trust, assertion handling, and reliance on upstream identity providers are aligned with SP 800-63C principles while remaining protocol-agnostic.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Federation represents a shared trust fabric; disruption or compromise requires resilience, detection, and recovery controls aligned with SP 800-184.

metadata.remarks:
Identity Federation defines the capability to accept, validate, and rely upon identity assertions issued by external organizations under explicitly governed trust relationships. Federation enables cross-organizational access while preserving local policy control, accountability, and auditability.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, and assurance related to federated identity. Identity semantics are defined in Identity Core; federation governs external trust.

components.title: Trust Relationships
components.description: Establishment and governance of trust relationships with external identity providers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise or modification of federated authentication or trust configuration.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit governance of inter-organizational trust relationships.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define and govern federation architecture and agreements.

components.title: Assertion Consumption
components.description: Validation and consumption of identity assertions from trusted external identity providers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid federated accounts or assertions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strict validation of issuer, audience, and integrity of federated assertions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Ensure federated identities are uniquely identified.
Protect and validate federated authenticators and assertions.

components.title: External Identity Assurance
components.description: Evaluation and enforcement of assurance levels associated with external identity assertions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Acceptance of low-assurance external identity attributes.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Enforcement of minimum assurance levels for federated identities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Assess and enforce assurance requirements for federated identities.
Incorporate attributes and assurance claims into decisions.

components.title: Responsibility Boundaries
components.description: Definition and enforcement of responsibility boundaries between the institution and external identity providers.

props.name: attack-technique

props.name: defense-technique

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define access control responsibilities across trust boundaries.
